task: Combined independent pre-merge review for #2524 and #2525
disposition: Pre-merge verdict. Re-run after merging current main.

claim.issue2524: Remove seven confirmed unread public view/result fields while preserving same-named persistence/domain/external concepts.

finding.severity: blocking cleanup incompleteness / test-only false confidence
finding.summary: Four of the seven removed public fields remain in client test wire fixtures. The production projectors omit them, but routeTrpc responders are deliberately unknown/untyped and accept the stale extra keys, so typecheck and CT stay green against responses production can no longer emit.
finding.expected: Client wire fixtures for RuleView, FireView, CharacterSummary, and PluginView omit the removed fields, matching the production response shapes.
finding.counterexample: The scoped CT run included rules-section.ct.tsx, characters-section.ct.tsx, and plugin-primary-cta.suite.ct.tsx and passed 66/66 while each family supplied at least one removed field. This directly demonstrates that green CT/typecheck do not prove the test wire models were cleaned.

confirmedSubclaims: Production declarations and projectors for all seven named view/result fields are removed in the reviewed diff.

The same-named persistence/domain concepts remain where required: automation rule error ledger, automation fire/event depth, CharacterDetail/content hashes, ChatDetail/fork lineage, and plugin crash counter.

loadTurnForClassify is absent from TS and TSX identifiers/calls and its export/tests/comments were removed. The overlapping chat persistence edit is clean: isNotNull disappeared only with loadChatParticipantCharacterIds, while loadTurnForClassify removal shares no surviving import.

ChatSummary participantCharacterIds and CredentialView.hasMetadata have no surviving TS/TSX member access or property-signature matches in the scanned code scope. Same-spelled local/domain concepts remain intentionally.

structuralEvidence.literalCorroboration: rg found no loadTurnForClassify code occurrence. It found the stale test fixture keys listed in the finding and preserved same-named concepts.

verification.command: pnpm typecheck --config packages/client/tsconfig.json --config packages/server/tsconfig.json --config tsconfig.json --config tsconfig.tests-dom.json

limitations: This is a pre-merge verdict against uncommitted changes on HEAD 41ae2d2e while main had advanced to 78e9989d5; integration with current main was not assessed.
No whole-repository check or full behavioral suite was run; targeted native typecheck, 222 scoped node tests, and 66 scoped CTs were reproduced.
